quests.title: Returns at Cabramatta
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. I am sending back 79 papers a day from Cabramatta and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Cabramatta
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. They will drop my Cabramatta order if I can show $45 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the long weekend. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $45, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Cabramatta Round
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I do the Cabramatta round from the back of seven and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Cabramatta
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. There is a dog on the Cabramatta round that has had two of my bags and a docket book that was not even mine. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Cabramatta
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Nine of us at Cabramatta have gone in on the same numbers since the long weekend and one of us has stopped putting money in. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$79, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Cabramatta
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The agency at Canley Vale closed six months before Cabramatta started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Parramatta
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. There has been a car in the Parramatta yard since school holidays with a whiteboard with last March still on it on the passenger seat and no owner answering. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Parramatta
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Now that it is documented, Parramatta is owed $50 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $50, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Parramatta
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I am in my first year at Parramatta and I have to log 66 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Parramatta
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Somebody has been coming into the Parramatta yard after half six to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Parramatta
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. My car has been at Parramatta since school holidays and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $66. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Parramatta
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Parramatta works out of Tramway Avenue, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Auburn
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. People leave things at the Auburn roller door after the back of seven and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Auburn
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. The photos worked, which means Auburn can claim back the $59 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since a public holiday nobody remembered. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $59, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Auburn
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Something came into Auburn on a public holiday nobody remembered in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Auburn
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Two people have been coming into the Auburn sorting room since a public holiday nobody remembered and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$47, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Auburn
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I do the Auburn pick-ups in a van with 47 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: come out to Lidcombe with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Auburn
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Everything Auburn cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Lidcombe, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
